other_conditions: The biological single parent(s) must be domiciled in Haryana or employed by the Government of Haryana
The family must have no son (biological or adopted)
The family must have one or more girl children
The benefit is payable to the mother, or to the father if the mother is deceased
The benefit starts after either parent turns 45 years of age
benefits_summary: ₹2,500 per month for 15 years, payable to the mother (or father if mother is deceased) after a parent reaches 45 years of age.
